setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 alone, C, C, C, D, from channel and step masks: Note C3 (60), Vel 80, and on step 13 Note D3 (62) at Vel 50; NOTE MASKS CH01 is open. Channel 2 plays pattern 2 (degrees 0 and 4, octave -1) as MIDI 48 and 55. The merge Strategy is still All, which changes nothing with one pattern. Scale slot 1 is C major and the tempo is 90 BPM.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Note and turn E3 left until it reads X (no mask). NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note X: the channel no longer decides the pitch, the pattern notes will.
steps.title: Let the pattern notes through

steps.caption: Hold (13,4) and press K2: the tooltip reads Masks for step 13 cleared, and K2 removes every mask on the step, so its Note 62 and Vel 50 both go. Then select Vel, turn E3 left 30 detents to 50 while still holding: NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note X and Vel 50, the quiet ending back on step 13 alone. Release (13,4).
steps.title: Restore the quiet ending

steps.caption: Release (13,4). NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note X and Vel 80 (the channel defaults); step 13's own Vel 50 only shows while you hold it.
steps.title: Back to the channel defaults

steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8), choose pattern 1 at (1,1), tap Pattern (5,8) again for the note view and tap (1,7), (5,7), (9,7) and (13,6): degree 0 on steps 1, 5 and 9, and degree 1, one row up and the next note of the scale, on step 13. PATTERN NOTE PAT01 CH01 shows the tooltip Step 13 note set to 1.
steps.title: Write the melody as degrees

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), play two passes and stop. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding 60, 60, 60, 62 from the pattern's own notes, step 13 at velocity 50, and channel 2 sounding 48 and 55.
steps.title: Play it from the pattern

steps.caption: Tap Scale (4,8) to open the scale page, tap scale slot 2 at (2,3), then play two passes and stop. While it plays the screen shows SCALE SLOT 02 with Root C and Scale Major. Slot 2 holds C major like slot 1, so nothing changes: the MIDI strip shows 60, 60, 60, 62 on channel 1 and 48 and 55 on channel 2. Ignore the Degree and Transpose rows on this page; they stay at I and 0.
steps.title: Prepare a second scale

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Root and turn E3 right two detents to D. SCALE SLOT 02 shows Root D, Scale Major and the line Press K3 to confirm. The change is only a draft until K3, so playback would still use C major.
steps.title: Draft D as the root

steps.caption: Turn E2 down to Scale. SCALE SLOT 02 shows Scale Major beside the draft Root D, and Press K3 to confirm is still on screen: nothing is applied yet.
steps.title: Check the Scale row

steps.caption: Press K3 to apply: the Press K3 to confirm line disappears. Play two passes and stop. While it plays SCALE SLOT 02 shows Root D and the Play pad (1,8) is lit. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 sounding 62, 62, 62, 64 (the last at velocity 50) and channel 2 sounding 50 and 57: the same rhythm in D major.
steps.title: Apply D major

steps.caption: Tap scale slot 1 at (1,3), press K3 to apply, then play two passes and stop. SCALE SLOT 01 shows Root C. The MIDI strip shows channel 1 back on 60, 60, 60, 62 and channel 2 on 48 and 55.
steps.title: Return to C major

title: 7. Change harmony without changing the rhythm
